facts.what: 脑中排练 Mrs Cassie Munro，却甩不掉不配感
facts.anchor: Mrs Cassie Munro sounds perfect for me.

facts.what: 得知他 34 岁、不/不能开车、住处与她相近、教课排满
facts.anchor: ageing like a fine wine at thirty-four, doesn’t, or can’t, drive

facts.what: 认定他是好灵魂、绝不会拿她的话对付她
facts.anchor: He would never use anything I’ve done or said against me

facts.what: 感觉灵魂两半合体，从没人这样努力理解她
facts.anchor: two halves of one soul are finally uniting

facts.what: 提议走到他家坐坐、可叫车或送她回家，坦言不想结束今晚
facts.anchor: I’ll be completely honest with you…I don’t want to end the night yet.

facts.what: 一路交代年龄、职业、无友、与父母疏远
facts.anchor: I’ve confessed my age, my career history, my lack of friends, and my relationship with my estranged parents

facts.what: 门口把她抵门又弹开；她道歉后他将她抱起猛吻
facts.anchor: he snaps back like an elastic band, pinging away from me, leaving behind nothing but the sharp sting

facts.what: 说他从没这种感觉、她 perfect
facts.anchor: ‘I’ve never felt this way before. You’re perfect, Cassie. Just perfect.’

relations: Cassie 与 Finlay 约会结束；他邀她去住处；两人首次深吻
